```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a pairplot to visualize the relationships between all features
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.pairplot(data, hue='species', markers=['o', 's', 'D'], palette=['blue', 'green', 'red'])
plt.title('Iris Flower Species Classification Dataset')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
